info.title: 3dprint4.me native partner API
info.description: Native transport, typed command inputs/results, resource responses and canonical queries. This contract does not imply deployment or professional clearance. Unknown query keys and duplicate query values are rejected. Successful and error JSON is private no-store. Request JSON accepts application/json and +json media types. Structural schemas do not establish current ownership, lifecycle, balances or professional clearance. Opaque private evidence/settings JSON and SQL-backed additional row fields remain deliberately extensible.

Status400.description: Invalid JSON, fields or domain input.

Status401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or invalid credentials.

Status403.description: Origin, CSRF, role or eligibility denied.

Status409.description: Revision, capacity, replay-payload or lifecycle conflict.

Status422.description: Consent, contact, visit outcome or placement validation failed.

partnerCookie.name: __Host-3dp-partner
partnerCookie.description: HttpOnly; Secure; Path=/; SameSite=Strict. Never expose cookie values in browser JavaScript.

ownerCookie.name: __Host-3dp-session
ownerCookie.description: Independent existing owner identity session; partner cookie cannot grant owner access.

OfferTerms.description: Deadline is no later than 2026-12-31. Fee plus maximum bonus cannot exceed 40000 cents. Bonus IDs are unique; sum(amountCents*maximumAwards) must equal maximumBonusCents (default zero).

FollowUpContact.description: Email syntax and phone normalization/digit count are validated by the server; preferredContact must name a provided usable value.

TemplateVariables.description: Default values must validate against the declared type; variable references must be registered. Names and used bindings are exact and validated server-side.

TemplateBindings.description: Only names registered by the exact stored version are accepted. Types/lengths/defaults/required values follow its TemplateVariables.

CommandInput_program_create.description: Start date must be no later than 2026-12-31. The pilot never automatically renews.

CommandInput_program_configure.description: Activation requires current recorded professional clearance and independently enabled environment gates.

CommandInput_program_week_cap.description: weekStart is a Monday Central date. Expected revision is zero for a new authorization week; reductions preserve earned obligations.

CommandInput_partner_invite.description: Purpose defaults to enroll. Authentication operation: body key does not deduplicate. Each issuance revokes prior unused invitations.

CommandInput_partner_revoke.description: Status defaults to revoked. Authentication operation, outside application command receipts.

CommandInput_gig_decline.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_submit.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_request_cancel.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_report_unsafe.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_dispute.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_withdraw.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_approve.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_request_changes.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_gig_make_payable.description: Current lifecycle, account ownership and revision are validated on the server.

CommandInput_material_record.description: Labels are NFKC/case-normalized for duplicate and return checks. New supply requires accepted/changes-requested work. Returns cannot exceed complete recorded supply. No compensation changes.

CommandInput_visit_record.description: Visit time must follow acceptance and be no more than five minutes ahead. Consent is explicit; personal contact/purpose require consent. Material placement requires permission. No-soliciting permits only declined/unavailable with zero samples.

CommandInput_lead_correct.description: A changed contact requires consent=true and renewed purpose-specific permission. Unchanged corrections retain existing permission.

CommandInput_profile_update.description: Optional email/phone/accessibility accept null or empty to clear. Chosen contact preference must exist in the resulting profile. Email and phone syntax are validated by the server; default notificationOptOut is true.

CommandInput_statement_export.description: OWNER must provide partnerId; PARTNER always exports its own statement and cannot select another account.

CommandInput_finance_export.description: Inclusive Central calendar dates; from must not follow through. Existing exports prevent duplicate accounting rows.

CommandInput_payment_record.description: Actual independent settlement evidence is required. Reference cannot be a URL. Amount cannot exceed outstanding obligation; time cannot be over five minutes ahead.

CommandInput_payment_reverse.description: Only an original settlement can be reversed once. Reversal time must follow its settlement and cannot be over five minutes ahead.

CommandInput_payable_adjust.description: Verified external resolution cannot erase settled value or create negative debt.

CommandInput_gig_reconcile.description: Only disputed/cancellation-requested/changes-requested accepted work is eligible; independently verified external resolution cannot erase settled value.

CommandInput_referral_attribute.description: Request ID is an opaque service-request ID, not necessarily a UUID. Server verifies opted-in source, chronology, participant exclusion and uniqueness.

CommandInput_referral_verify_sale.description: Reference cannot be a URL; server checks independent settlement, chronology and participant exclusion. Quotes/return URLs do not verify payment.

CommandInput_referral_award.description: Exactly the source matching the accepted frozen rule is required; server checks qualification/settlement, caps, deadline and duplicate claims.

CommandInput_legal_save.description: Markdown text only: no HTML, images, active links, URL credentials/query strings or unregistered template variables. Draft notices cannot be marked issue-ready. Minimum scopes are added server-side.

CommandInput_legal_record_review.description: Exact package/version/hash/granted reviewer/scope must match. Accounting requires CPA; other scopes require attorney. Review time must be within the grant and not future; expiry follows review time.

CommandInput_legal_resolve_comment.description: Resolution refers to the same document and same/newer revision; an existing resolution cannot be overwritten.

CommandInput_legal_issue.description: Bindings follow the exact stored version variable schema. Issuance requires current published exact hash, role reviews, program gates and active partner.

CommandInput_agreement_acknowledge.description: Acknowledges reading the exact owned issued snapshot; does not constitute an electronic signature.

CommandInput_legal_export_package.description: Named reviewer role/name pairs must be unique; expiry is after now and within 30 days. Private signing must be configured. Source documents and facts remain private.

CommandInput_legal_import_feedback.description: Canonical base64 of a DOCX with 1–524288 decoded bytes. Grant/hash/identity/expiry, ZIP limits and supported DOCX structures are revalidated; import does not mutate source text or approvals.

OfferSnapshot.description: Normalized runtime output. Distinct from canonical OfferTerms input: runtime offer text permits DEL U+007F. Monetary/policy consistency is checked before storage.

week_start_local.description: Unnormalized SQL DATE from the configured driver; serialized as date or midnight timestamp. Calendar-week semantics remain Central local dates.

token.description: One-time private handoff secret. Never log, cache publicly or embed in a URL.

week_start_local.description: Unnormalized SQL DATE from the configured driver; serialized as date or midnight timestamp. Calendar-week semantics remain Central local dates.
